How do payments work for events and providers?

The organiser decides whether to pass the fee on to guests – the total price is shown before purchase. Providers are booked and paid directly with the provider – not through Pickeed. Pickeed doesn't broker anything there and takes no commission.

/hilfe.title: Help centre – Pickeed
/hilfe.description: Answers to common questions about Pickeed. Can't find what you need? Write to us – we usually reply within 1–2 working days.
body: Answers to common questions about Pickeed. Can't find what you need? Write to us – we usually reply within 1–2 working days.
See what’s on and go with your friends. Follow friends, creators and places in your city. And when something grabs you, one tap turns it into a plan.
Pickeed is free. For private people, creators, companies and brands, Pickeed is free – create plans, invite guests, post and follow.
Can people join without an account?
Yes. Anyone who opens an invite link can choose «Join without an account» and just enter a name.
How do we find a date that works?

Time Pick finds the date: Pickeed suggests a time when most people can make it (from your availability and, if connected, your calendars). Everyone says «Works» or «Doesn't work» – as soon as enough agree, the date is set.
Can I use Pickeed without the app?

In the browser you can look around Pickeed without installing anything, join via an invite link – even as a guest without an account – and manage your profile and settings. Posting, creating plans and events, chats and status are in the Pickeed app.
Weddings, parties, birthdays, henna nights and more – planned by private people who deliberately make their event public and welcome guests.
Pickeed is for people aged 16 and over.
How do I connect by QR code («Got Pickeed?»)?

Skip swapping numbers: in your profile go to ☰ → «My QR code» to show your code full screen. The other person taps ＋ → «Scan QR code» (or under «People») and points the camera at it – your profile opens with «Follow». If you scan each other within a minute, you’re connected right away («You’re now connected»); otherwise you confirm the request as usual.

The camera image stays on your device; Pickeed doesn’t store it. Without a camera you can use a photo or screenshot of the code. Under 18, the code always leads to your personal follow link (no public page). Businesses and creators use the same code for the counter, flyers or a show.

Private is for you – for friends, family and your club. Creator is for people whose name is at the center: influencers, musicians, DJs, artists, athletes, photographers, models, stars. Business is for a brand or a team: businesses, brands, restaurants, clubs, hotels, agencies, associations, schools, running clubs.

Every account has its own sign-in and can follow, post photos and share memories. Provider is not an account type: want to sell, rent out or take bookings? Add the provider feature – to any account. Not sure? You can add more accounts later (up to five on one device) and switch with one tap.
How do I keep private and business separate?

The simplest way is two accounts: private with your private email, the business with the business email. New: «Switch account» (name at the top of your profile ▾) → «Add account» → «Business». Both stay signed in on your device; you switch with one tap, without signing in again. Each account only sees its own plans, chats and notifications.

Already have the business in your private account? In the business profile go to «Manage business area» → «Set up own sign-in»: business email (confirmed by code) and password – from then on the business signs in on its own and you stay owner. In the team you assign roles: Owner (everything), Admin (profile, events, team), Employee and Guest. If your private account uses the business email, create a private account with its own email and move your private plans and memories («Move private plans», can be undone for 30 days). Business plans always stay with the business.

If you don’t choose one, you automatically get one from your name, e.g. lea.graf – under 18 or with «Show first name only» just your first name and four digits (zoe.4821). You can change it at any time under «Edit profile».

Every username exists only once on Pickeed – across people, businesses, creators and providers. Allowed are 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot and underscore. If the name you want is taken, Pickeed suggests three free variants.

You can change it twice in 14 days (replacing the automatic one doesn’t count). The old one redirects to the new one for 90 days and stays blocked for everyone else during that time. Share your page as pickeed.com/@name.
Businesses, creators and providers can also add a phone number to their profile. With “Show phone on profile”, signed-in visitors see a “Call” button under “Contact” – never in search.
How do I sign in – do I need a password?
No. You enter your email address and receive a six-digit code. The code is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. You can also sign in with Google or Apple.
A password is optional: under Profile → Account and security you can set one if you'd like to sign in without access to your inbox.
No code arrived? Check your spam folder and the spelling of your address. After several attempts you have to wait 15 minutes.
How do I change my email address?

Profile → Account and security → «Change email». You receive a code at the new address, and your previous address confirms the change by link or code. If you no longer have access to the previous address, the code for the new one is enough – the previous address then gets a notice and can undo the change for 7 days.
Plans, roles, Google/Apple sign-in and payments stay the same. If you can't get into your account at all, support can help via the contact form.
How old do I have to be to use Pickeed?

Pickeed is for people aged 16 and over. To sell tickets (payouts via Stripe), you must be at least 18. At 16 and 17 you can join all public events except «18+». At events by businesses, creators and clubs you take part without the chat until you’re 18, and the account doesn’t see your name – you still get time changes and cancellations. Details are in the terms and the privacy policy.
App or browser – what's the difference?

Same account, same plans, same data. In the browser you can look around Pickeed without installing anything, join via an invite link – even as a guest without an account – and manage your profile and settings. Posting, creating plans and events, chats and status are in the Pickeed app. The iPhone and Android app also sends notifications to your phone, opens invite links directly and adds dates to your calendar.
How do I share my profile?

On your profile, next to «Edit profile», tap «Share profile». There you can copy the link, share it from your phone, show or save the QR code and create a story image. Creators, providers, businesses and clubs find the same button on their page – with an extra banner for the link in your bio.

Your link pickeed.com/@name works as soon as you choose a @username under «Edit profile» (18 and over, with «Findable in search» on). Others only see your name, your picture and your username there and can follow you – with a private account, you approve every request. Plans, memories, where you live and your age never appear. Without a @username, and under 18, you share your personal follow link with a QR code.
Can guests take part without an account?
Yes. Anyone who opens an invite link can choose «Join without an account» and just enter a name. Guests vote, chat and say what they'll bring – only in that one plan and on that device.
They can create an account at any time later; everything is kept.

In the plan under «Invite» you create a link for one person or a group link for several. Links expire, can have a usage limit and can be revoked individually. Personal links only work for one person – forwarding them has no effect.
For public events, simply share the event page.
What are Time Pick and Idea Pick?

Time Pick finds the date: Pickeed suggests a time when most people can make it (from your availability and, if connected, your calendars). Everyone says «Works» or «Doesn't work» – as soon as enough agree, the date is set.
Idea Pick finds the what: suitable ideas and offers for your group, which you suggest in the chat and vote on. Things that aren't for you (Profile → Preferences) are never suggested.
How do I plan something in one sentence?

Tap ＋ and write what you're planning – for example «BBQ on Saturday at 6pm with Lea and Marco». On your device, Pickeed recognises the right template, day, time, place and people from «My people» and shows a preview straight away. «Create plan» creates the plan, invites people you know directly and opens sharing for everyone else. Without a day, Time Pick finds the date; «weekend» or «next week» become date suggestions. Everything can be changed in the plan.

On cards in «Your Pick» and in «Waiting for you», you answer with one tap: «I'm in», «Maybe» or «Not in» (for Time Pick «Works» or «Doesn't work»). At the top of a plan there is always exactly one next step; tasks, costs and other sections are under «＋ Add». Pressing and holding a card opens quick actions, swiping switches tabs in a plan.
What is a status in Circle?

At the top of «Your Pick», «Spontaneous · Circle» shows what’s happening today. Every account can show a status there that disappears by itself at the end of the day (or at the time you choose): privately «Free today?», as a business «Looking for someone?» (starts a short-notice request, e.g. for a temp or a DJ), as a creator «Available today?» – «Available at short notice» or «In … today» (city only, 18+). The suggestions are just shortcuts; you can also write your own short text. Tap it and «Remove status» takes it down right away. Who sees your status: privately your confirmed followers, as a creator the followers of your page and businesses with a matching request.
What does my profile statistics page show?

Businesses, creators and providers see «Your overview» at the top of their profile with profile views in the last 30 days. Tap it to open the statistics: views per day (7, 30 or 90 days), new followers, how often website, «Contact», share and events were tapped, «I'm in» and tickets sold for your public events, and how often your status was seen in Circle. These are totals only – no one sees who viewed a profile. Your own views, your team's and bots don't count. For businesses, only the organisation sees the statistics. The e-mail under «Contact» only appears if you turn on «Show e-mail on profile» in «Edit profile».
How do I delete a plan or my account?
Plan: in the plan under ⋯ → «Delete plan» (main organiser only). All members are told; photos are removed immediately.

Account: Profile → «Delete account», confirmed by email. Personal data is deleted; posts in groups remain as «Deleted account». If you're the only organiser of a business with other people, hand over the role first.
Yes. Profile → Account and security → «Download my data»: you get a ZIP file with your details, plans, messages and photos (JSON plus images).
How do I set up a running club?

Tap «＋» → «Activities» → «Running Club». The run happens every week by default; you add the meeting point, distance and pace groups (e.g. «Easy ~6:30/km»). «All paces welcome» is already on. Anyone who joins picks their pace group with one tap.

Clubs, creators and companies mark their page as a «Running Club» with a city in their settings. The page then shows «Running Club · Zurich», and your public runs appear under Discover → Picks → «Activities» and for people who like running. After a run you can share a group photo as a memory.
How do tickets and refunds work?

You buy tickets for public events through the Pickeed checkout (Stripe, with TWINT or card). The seller is the event's organiser – they set the price, cancellation and refund rules and are responsible for them. The confirmation arrives by email; your ticket is on the event page.
If an event is cancelled, the organiser refunds via Stripe. If there's a problem, contact the organiser first; if that doesn't work, use «Report a problem».
How do I report or block someone?
Report: on a message, event, offer or profile, tap ⋯ → «Report». Moderators only see a snapshot of the reported content, never your chat.

Block: on any profile (including creator and business pages) tap ⋯ → «Block», or on a message. You'll no longer see each other's messages or be able to invite each other. You manage blocked accounts under Settings → «Blocked».
Who can message me and comment?

Settings › Privacy (businesses and creators: «… manage»): «Who can message you?» – Everyone (strangers as a request), Mutual only (you follow each other) or No one (existing chats only). «Who can comment?» is the default for new posts and can be changed when posting; you can turn «Replies to your status» off completely.

You can mute or lock individual chats and groups (long-press in the list or ⋯ in the chat). Locked chats sit in the «Locked chats» folder and only open with Face ID, fingerprint or a Pickeed code by email; their notifications show no content. This only applies to you – the others notice nothing.

With an open call, businesses, providers or organisers look for creators, DJs, models and others for an occasion. Matching creators get a notification (at most one email a day, can be turned off) and apply directly. The poster decides and messages applicants – without contact details becoming public.

When you plan a trip, the Travel Guide in the plan shows the essentials for the destination: emergency numbers, entry notes, a packing list by type of trip, ideas and tips from other travellers. Pickeed loads the map through its own server – map providers don't see who you are.

In «For you» every card has an ⓘ: it shows the 1–3 main reasons, e.g. «You and Lea have already made 3 plans together», «2 people you follow are going» or «It’s soon». Your friends’ plans always come before content from businesses, creators and providers; that content is labelled and limited. Via ⓘ you can mute a business. «Friends» stays sorted by date.
How does Pickeed make suggestions – and what does it know about me?

Pickeed only uses data from your account: shared plans, your city, types you join and your search history. No external AI service, no selling of data. Under Profile → Settings → «What does Pickeed know about me?» you see everything, can turn off «Personalise suggestions» and delete the history. Under 16, suggestions are never personal; under 18, business content is never sorted personally.

No. No ad banners, no tracking or advertising cookies, no third-party analytics. Servers and data are in Switzerland. For our own figures we only count totals (e.g. «how many plans this week»), never what a particular person does. Details are in the privacy policy.
How do I set up notifications?

Profile → Notifications: for each type (chat, dates, reminders, bring/tasks, tickets, open calls) you choose push and email. For chat there's «All», «Mentions only» or «None». Account and moderation notices always arrive. Pickeed doesn't send advertising. Quiet hours (10 pm–8 am) hold push until the morning; you can mute individual plans in the plan.
Is Pickeed running? Go to the status page

/datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy – Pickeed
/datenschutz.description: Pickeed privacy policy: which data we process, why and where it is stored – under Swiss data protection law.
body: All language versions of this privacy policy are equally complete.

Pickeed is built to collect as little data as possible: plans are private by default, there are no ad banners and no tracking, and we do not analyse your chat messages. This page explains exactly which data we process, why and where it is stored. This policy follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Representative in the EU and the United Kingdom (Art. 27 GDPR / UK GDPR): the appointment is in progress. Until then, please contact us directly at the address above for any data protection questions.

Your email address, the name you choose and the language you use for Pickeed. To sign in, we send you a six-digit code; we only store a check value of it, it is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. After signing in, a session cookie keeps you signed in as long as you use Pickeed at least every 30 days. A password is optional (see «Account, password and profile»). If you change your email address, we keep the previous and the new address for 30 days so the change can be confirmed and undone within 7 days; the log only shows both in shortened form.
Date of birth and age checks

When you sign up, you enter your date of birth – also when you sign in with Google or Apple and when you create a business or creator account directly. We need it to check whether you may use Pickeed (from 16), to switch on the protection for young people until 18 (see «Protection until 18») and for features from 18. Your date of birth is never public: others see at most the day and month if you turn on «Show birthday». In the age check, our team only sees your age, not the date. You cannot remove your date of birth. While you are under 18, you cannot change it to an earlier date; if it is wrong, write to us. Your date of birth is included in your data export; we delete it with your account.

Accounts created before this rule are asked once for their date of birth; you can choose «Later». For features from 18 you then enter it. Accounts that have never confirmed the minimum age (for example older sign-ins with Google or Apple) can only change anything again once they enter their date of birth.

If the date of birth gives an age under 16, we do not create an account and do not store the date of birth. So that a second attempt with a different date is not possible straight away, we store for 30 days a non-reversible check value (hash) of your email address and of a random device ID. The device ID is kept for 30 days in the cookie «pk_ak» on your device. After that the check values no longer apply, and we delete them. If an account has never confirmed the minimum age and the date of birth it adds gives an age under 16, we delete the account and block the email address and device for 30 days in the same way.

If an existing private account later enters a date of birth under 16, we do not store the date. We pause the account and our team reviews it; in the age check it only sees the note «date of birth under 16».

You can report a person with the reason «This person is under 16». A single report only goes to our team. If at least two independent people report, we pause the private account until our team has reviewed it. Reports from accounts that are less than 24 hours old only go to our team, and one person can pause at most 3 accounts per day this way. Once our team has confirmed the age, a report no longer pauses the account.

While an account is paused, others cannot see it – like a blocked account. The person stays signed in, sees an explanation and can only: write to our team, download their data, delete the account, sign out devices for notifications, sign out and change the language. During this time they cannot act as a business or creator.

Our team decides: age confirmed (the account is active again), close the case without action, or delete the account. If our team deletes an account because the person is under 16, we block the email address for 30 days as a check value. We record every decision with its reason in the log of the admin area. For the account we store when it was paused and when our team confirmed the age.

If your account is paused, you can write to our team in the app – text only, at most 1000 characters and at most 5 messages in 24 hours. You cannot upload an ID document in the app. We store your message with the time; only the moderation team sees it. Our team receives a notice by email without your text and replies to you by email at your account’s address. We delete the messages when our team closes the case, at the latest after 180 days and in any case with your account.

When you, as a private account, save text in «About me», a post or a memory, a comment on a memory, plan or status, a status or a guestbook entry, our server automatically checks whether it contains an age under 16 (for example «I’m 13» or a school year). If it finds one, we store only the expression found (at most 40 characters), the type of text and the time – not the whole text. Our team sees this expression and decides itself; there is no automatic block. We do not check chats this way. Once our team has confirmed your age, we no longer check. We delete these notes when our team closes the case, at the latest after 180 days.

Legal basis: we process this data to comply with the minimum age and to protect young people (legitimate interest; Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, in Switzerland Art. 31(1) FADP). We also need the date of birth because the age limits are part of our terms (contract).

If you are 16 or 17, you have a normal account with special protection until your 18th birthday. Your profile stays private. In search and suggestions, only people you follow or who follow you can find you; «Appear in suggestions» stays off until 18. Adults can first only send you a request – a single text message, even if you follow them. It appears in the «Requests» folder; only once you accept it is the chat open. Business and creator accounts can never write to you first; if you write to them, the chat can continue afterwards. If someone you do not follow invites you to a group or a plan, you receive an invitation that you can accept or decline. Only people you follow or whose follow request you have accepted can comment, reply or give hearts on your content; only people you follow can tag you. Creating offers, creating open calls, buying paid tickets, selling tickets, subscriptions, paid creator bookings and meetups and experiences are available from 18; free tickets from 16. «Nearby» only shows you plans from friends (you follow each other) and no public events; only friends who follow each other with you see your own plans there. You can have a creator page from 16: it is public, your private profile stays private, we never show a contact email, and if you apply to an open call, the other side sees the note «minor (16–17)». The GIF search only shows you GIFs rated «G». You can join public events unless they are «18+». At events by business, creator, club and provider accounts (and at public events such an account takes part in), you take part without the chat: you don’t see the event chat and can’t write there; the organisers and other participants don’t see your name or profile – only that one more person is coming; a request reaches the organisers without your name. The account can’t message you; you do get Pickeed notifications about the event (e.g. a time change or cancellation). Business and creator accounts never join plans you created. The protection ends automatically on your 18th birthday.

What you and your group enter in a plan: name, place, dates, messages, suggestions, votes, wish lists, lists of what to bring, tasks, budget and cost details, yes and no replies. Only members of the plan can see this content. For public events, the name, place, time and description are public – the group chat remains visible to members only.

Date poll: if someone suggests dates in a plan, you answer each date with «Works», «Maybe» or «Can’t». We store your answer with the time. Plan members see for each date how many and who answered what (name and profile picture). In plans where guests only get updates, guests see only the numbers and their own answer. If «Decide straight away on a clear majority» is on (default), Pickeed fixes a date itself as soon as more than half of the expected people have said «Works»; the organiser can undo this within an hour. Your answers are included in your data export.

If you follow a creator, provider or company page or save a public event, we store this with the time in your account. Whoever runs a page sees the people who follow it (name and profile picture) and can remove them; publicly the page only shows the numbers «Followers» and «Following» (can be hidden). You only follow a person once they confirm your request: they see your name and profile picture for this; if they decline, you are not told. Only you can see your «Following» list and your followers; who follows whom is never public, and there are no counts for others. You can remove followers silently at any time. Anyone who has your personal follow link only sees your first name and picture (never in search engines); you can create a new link at any time. After a meetup you shared, we may suggest following someone from it – only as a suggestion you can hide; we never follow anyone automatically. If one of you blocks the other, we remove the follow in both directions; if the page or event is deleted or you delete your account, we delete the entries. «My data» contains your list, your followers and your interests.

Search: all signed-in people can find you by your name or @username in the search and under «Find people» (like on Instagram). For a private account they only see your name, profile photo, @username and «Request to follow» – your content only once you approve the request. People you have blocked never find you. There is no switch to remove yourself from search. People aged 16 and 17 can only be found by those who follow them or whom they follow (see «Protection until 18»).

Suggestions «People you may know»: we suggest people from your shared plans and groups and people your people know – only through connections you are allowed to see yourself (private follower lists stay private). We never use chats, your location or contacts from your phone for this. You can turn off «Appear in suggestions» in Settings at any time; for people aged 16 and 17 it stays off until 18. Blocked people and people under «Hide from» never see you as a suggestion.

Memories and automatic image check: photos and videos you upload as a memory are checked automatically for sexual content – by a program on our own server in Switzerland; the images are not passed to any third party. Images clearly identified as such are not accepted. If the result is uncertain and the memory is meant to be public, our moderation sees only that one image before it becomes public; until then only the people you otherwise chose see it. Only the result of the check is stored with the image.

Payment details and «Split costs»: you can optionally save your IBAN and your PayPal.me name. Only people who owe you something in a shared plan according to «Split costs» can see them. Pickeed doesn’t move any money: «Pay» only copies the amount or opens the public PayPal.me link with the amount; what you do there is governed by PayPal’s terms. «Settled» only stores the amount, the people and the time in the plan. If you delete the details or your account, they are gone.

Birthday: you can optionally turn on «Show birthday» (off by default). Then only people who follow you and whom you follow see the day and month – never the year and never your age; blocked people and people under «Hide from» never do. Older accounts without a date of birth can enter only the day and month for this; then we store only those. Pickeed reminds people you’ve already shared a plan or group with a few days before (can be turned off under Notifications). If someone plans a surprise «Secret from» you, you won’t see that plan until you’re invited or the day is over.

On your home page, under «Your Pick», we show a limited list: plans by people you follow that they have shared with their followers, plans you have been personally invited to, and new public content (events, ideas, offers) from pages you follow. Whoever creates a plan chooses who can see it: only selected people, their followers, or public in Discover. The server checks this on every request – including images and previews. Followers can see the title, description, picture, place, date, the organiser’s name and picture and the number of members; participants’ names, chat and votes are only visible to members. If you show «interest», the organisers see your name; this is neither a commitment nor membership. Existing plans never appear in the feed. We do not use the feed for advertising or profiling and sort it only by invitation and date.

Public account and per-profile notifications: by default your account is private – you approve every new person. If you turn on «Public account», signed-in people can follow you without approval and see what you share with followers; your account is still not indexed by search engines. At 16 and 17 your account stays private (see «Protection until 18»). Following does not turn on notifications. Only if you turn on «Notifications for this profile» for a profile do we store this and send you one notification for each new item you are allowed to see. You never see «Only selected people» plans through following.

When you save ideas, we store them on your boards with title, source, your note and the time; your own photos on boards are private and never appear publicly or on the ideas wall. Only you see your boards – unless you share one with a plan as an «ideas collection»: then, for weddings and big celebrations, the organisers see and add to it, otherwise all members of that plan. If you share an idea («Share an idea», «Share a creation»), it is public straight away – even without an account, on its own page and in search engines (for new accounts only after 48 hours, otherwise after 24 hours): photos, title, description, tags, category, language and the source you chose (first name with initial, your username or a link). We never show where you live or other profile details. We remove photo data (GPS, camera) when uploading. We keep a link to your account for the limits (10 ideas per day) and for deletion. The Pickeed team reviews reported ideas and images under the rules for reports. You can withdraw any idea at any time; we then delete it with its photos and only keep its address so that search engines remove it. If you delete your account, we delete your boards and shared ideas. «My data» includes both. So that everyone can read an idea in their language, we have the title, description and tags of published ideas translated automatically by DeepL (DeepL SE, Cologne, Germany) – only the text of the idea, no names, source, links or other details about you. We store the translation with the idea and delete it together with the idea (withdrawal, removal, account deletion); it is marked «Automatically translated» and the original remains available.

Invitation links and QR codes contain a random key that we only store as a check value. Personal invitations can be revoked and do not open a second access when forwarded. If you add a personal message to an invitation link (optional, at most 120 characters), we store it with the link and only show it on the invitation page to people who have that link – never in link previews. It disappears with the link or when you clear it.

With an invitation link to a private plan, you can take part without an account. We then only store the first name you enter, your language and what you contribute to the plan (e.g. yes or no, votes, things to bring); a session cookie keeps you signed in as long as you use Pickeed at least every 30 days. You don't need an email address. To prevent abuse, we limit how many guests can join per hour from the same address; for this we store a check value of your IP address (not the IP itself) and delete it after one day.

Optionally, you can enter an email address so that we can write to you once the date is fixed or changes, or if the plan is cancelled. You first confirm it via a link; without confirmation we delete it after 7 days, and you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email. To prevent misuse of these emails, we store check values of the address and of the IP address for 30 days. If you later create an account or sign in, we move your contributions to your account and delete the guest data. Otherwise we delete the guest data when you choose to, when you leave or are removed from the plan, together with the plan, or at the latest after 12 months without activity; your contributions in the plan then appear as «Deleted account».

If you connect your calendar, we only read when you are busy. We do not take over the titles, places or attendees of your appointments. We store your calendar address encrypted. Reading and writing are separate permissions, and nobody can consent on behalf of someone else. You can disconnect at any time in your profile.

For company spaces we process the company name, teams, roles and which employees belong to them, as well as the content of company plans. Company plans are separate from private plans; the company does not see its employees' private plans. The company is responsible for the data in its company space; Pickeed processes it on the company's behalf (data processing on behalf, terms section 6b) and not for its own purposes. It is best to address requests about this data to your company; otherwise we forward them.
Providers store a profile, offers and images. We count per day how often an offer was viewed or suggested – without storing who it was. Bookings are made directly with the provider, not in Pickeed.

Offers from private individuals: from 18 you can also create offers as a private individual – with a picture, title, short description, price (free is possible) and optionally place and «When?». With your first offer Pickeed automatically creates a business profile with your name and the place from your profile, without email address or phone number. Your offers appear in your profile under «Offers», on your page pickeed.com/@name if you have one, and under Discover in Picks. We automatically check pictures for sexual content and links as for all offers. Contact runs through Pickeed messages; booking and payment do not happen in Pickeed.

Offers from providers with a provider plan are highlighted as «Partner» in Picks (once the provider plan is paid, with the note «Partner · paid placement»). In the suggestions for a plan, at most one offer per list appears as «Sponsored» – always labelled, only if it matches the plan anyway, and never ahead of the best-matching offer. Only the plan's details count for this (occasion, place, group size, budget and the group's dietary needs without names) – never chat messages and never personal details such as preferences or home town. Providers do not learn who their offer was shown to.

As a creator – a content creator or influencer, model, photographer, videographer, DJ, host, speaker, musician or artist – you set up your own page at pickeed.com/@name. Public – also without signing in, in search engines and as structured data (JSON-LD) for search engines, where your roles also appear as job title – are your name, username, picture, short bio, your roles, city or region, topics, your website and the links to your social media profiles, your own details on reach, audience and languages (marked as «Stated by the creator», not checked by Pickeed) and your published formats and fan events. We remove metadata such as the location from the picture. A contact email is optional: only signed-in people with an account can see it, for example companies looking for creators for an event – never visitors who are not signed in, guests without an account or search engines.

Companies see creators as suggestions matching the places and occasions of their company plans (for example a DJ, photography, hosting or music for a summer party, a speaker for a conference) and the filters they choose; for this we only use the place, template and title of company plans, never chats, and the plans stay private. Signed-in people with an account can search creators by role, place or region, language and topic and only see the public details and the optional contact email. As statistics we only store daily totals: views of your page by signed-in people (each person counts once per day; for this we store a check value of person, page and day, not a name, which we delete after 3 days) and clicks on «Get in touch». You only see these totals, never who. We keep the details and statistics as long as your creator profile exists. If you delete your creator profile or your account, we immediately delete the page, formats, picture, statistics and suggestions; fan events remain as normal events without any reference to your creator page.

Statistics and contact on company, creator and provider profiles (E-106): for the person managing the profile we only count daily totals – profile views, new followers, taps on website, «Contact», «Share» and events on the profile, «I'm in» and tickets sold for their own public events, and how often a status in Circle was seen. A view counts once per person (or, without signing in, per device from IP address and browser identifier) and day; for this we only store an encrypted check value, deleted after 3 days, never names or IP addresses. Your own views, your team's and automated access (bots) don't count. No one sees who viewed a profile. The e-mail address appears under «Contact» only if the profile has turned on «Show e-mail on profile», and only for signed-in people.

Views, plays and set card («statistik», «setcard-uebersicht»): If you post something, you only see daily totals – views, plays of videos (from 2 seconds), hearts, comments, saves and the share of views from followers. Everyone who may see a video also sees its number of plays. People with a public profile (18 and over) likewise only see totals in «Your overview»: profile views, accounts reached and new and lost followers per day. A post counts as seen after one second on screen; the app reports this bundled with the next request. Each person counts once per post and day; for this we only store an encrypted check value, which we delete after 3 days. Your own views do not count, and nobody ever sees who viewed something. Daily totals older than 90 days are combined into one total per post. You can share your set card (pictures from your public posts, one sentence, follower count, linked profiles) as a link and a picture; publicly it only shows what is public on your profile anyway, never views and never for people under 18. You can delete your set card at any time.

Anyone who organises a plan (privately, for a company or as a provider) or has a creator profile can publish an open call, for example «DJ for our summer party». For this we store roles, title, description, date, place or region (no address), languages, an optional guide fee, the application deadline and the maximum number of applications, as well as the plan it is posted from. Open calls are never public and never in search engines: only signed-in people with a creator profile and a matching role see them. They only see the fields of the open call and who is searching (for people, only the first name; otherwise the company, business or creator name) – never the plan, the chat, the members or any other details. At most 50 matching creators receive a notification (nearest first) and, unless they have turned it off, at most one email a day; for this we only use the roles, region and languages of their creator profile, never chats.

If you apply as a creator, we store your message (max. 600 characters), the formats you choose and an optional price; the person who posted the open call also sees your public creator page, not your account email. Only after accepting do they see the optional contact email of your creator profile and your links; you only see their account email if they explicitly turn this on. Otherwise contact goes through a message thread per application (text only) that only the two of you can see. Open calls, applications and messages can be reported; moderation then only sees an extract of the reported content. Pickeed doesn’t act as an intermediary and takes no commission. We delete closed open calls together with applications and messages 12 months after the event, and immediately with your account or creator profile; they are included in the data export. Creator suggestions in plans and in the provider or creator area are based only on the occasion type, name and place of the plans or from your offers and fan events – never from chats.
Creator invitations, founding creators, @ pages for providers and companies

As a creator you get a personal invite link (pickeed.com/c/…). We store the link, when it was created and revoked, and whether the invitation page shows your first name (yes by default, can be switched off in your creator area; never your full name). If someone creates a creator profile through your link, we store on that profile which creator profile invited them. Under «Joined through you» you only see the name and username of those public pages – no money, no leaderboard. The remembered invite code is stored only in your browser (30 days at most). «Founding creator» is awarded only by the Pickeed team (logged); the home page then shows at most six public cards per region. Share images (story and banner) are created on your device and are not uploaded; the link preview image only shows details from the public page. If you paste a link to Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, it is only read in your browser – Pickeed does not query those platforms.

Providers can optionally give their public page a username. Companies can switch on a public company or brand page (off by default, only the «organisation» role): it shows name, logo, username, category, short description, website, social media and public events – never employees, teams, internal plans, budgets or open calls. For «Verified brand» the Pickeed team sees the email address of the person who applied (checked against the website's domain). «Open campaigns for creators» is only shown to signed-in creators with a matching role (never public, never in search engines). Collaborations only appear if both the company and the creator agree, without figures or prices, and either side can remove them at any time. When the creator profile, the company page or the account is deleted, we delete links, references and collaborations; everything is included in the data export. Profiles of people, creators and companies can be prepared by the Pickeed team; they only go public once the person claims them with their own account (personal link, valid for 30 days, deleted afterwards).

In your profile you can enter preferences (e.g. Italian, cinema) and dietary requirements (e.g. vegan, gluten-free, halal). Pickeed uses them to suggest suitable restaurants and activities to your groups. Dietary requirements may allow conclusions about health or religion; we only process them because you enter them yourself, only for these suggestions, and the group never sees who they come from. Preferences only count once three members of a plan have answered. You can change or delete both at any time in your profile.

After an event you can give 1–5 stars, say whether you would go again and add a short comment. Only the group sees this; Pickeed only shows the average once there are at least two ratings, and comments appear with your name. In surveys by the organisers you answer with your name or – if the survey is anonymous – without it: we then only store that you have answered, separately from your answers and without any link to them; results are only shown once there are at least three answers (five in company plans), and not even we as operator can tell who answered what. If you delete your account, we delete your ratings and named answers.
Event building blocks (registration, diet, attendance, certificates)

If the organiser switches on these sections, we store per plan what you enter yourself: your yes or no with the number of guests and children and an optional reason for cancelling (only the organiser sees it), your pick-up point, your room preference and room, whether you attended (ticked off or via QR code or ticket) and whether a certificate of attendance was issued to you. Details about diet, allergies and accessibility can be health data: they are voluntary, we only store them with your explicit consent (tick box, stored with time and version), and if you withdraw it we delete these details in all plans; the organiser and the kitchen export only see counts, small counts (below three, below five in company plans) only as «fewer than …» (except in the guest list of private celebrations, see below) – your name and note only if you expressly allow it. Feedback surveys are anonymous; free text appears without names and results only once the survey is closed or the event is over, and only from three answers (five in company plans) by people who were in the plan before it started. The attendance QR code renews every few minutes. Our server creates the certificate of attendance (PDF with name, title, date, duration and organiser); only you and the organiser can access it. If you leave the plan or delete your account, we delete these details; they are included in your data export. In company plans, the company's organisation only sees the title, time and team of company plans for annual planning and only the budget, reason and log for budget approvals – never private plans, chats, photos or individual diet or feedback answers. External guests without an account (e.g. customers) only see the plan they were invited to. Templates only store sections, agenda, bring list, tasks and texts – no people, chats or photos, and no speaker names, document links or emergency numbers; company plans only as company templates. For big celebrations (guests and invitation card) you can voluntarily add first names for your companions and children and – with the same consent – their diet and allergies; children never need an account and are never in the chat. The organiser sees the first names in the guest list, diet and allergies only as counts – for private celebrations there and in the guest list CSV export as exact numbers, including small counts (in company plans, counts below five still only as «fewer than …»), and only from people who have given their consent; other guests never see the guest list or these counts. If you decline, we delete these details. Our server draws the invitation card from the cover image and the organiser's details; it only appears in link previews (e.g. WhatsApp) if the organiser switches this on.

You sign in with a code by email or – if you set one – with email and password. We never store the password in plain text, only as a scrypt hash with its own salt; nobody at Pickeed can read it. We count failed sign-in attempts for 15 minutes to slow down guessing. You stay signed in as long as you use Pickeed at least every 30 days. «About me» and home town are optional. You enter your date of birth when you sign up (see «Date of birth and age checks»). Only people you share a plan or an organisation with can see «About me»; others only see your birthday if you turn on «Show birthday», and only with day and month. Only you can see your home town; Pickeed only uses it on the server to suggest fair meeting points. When you delete your account, we delete this information too.

Signing in with Google or Apple is optional. Pickeed redirects you to Google or Apple; you sign in there and allow us to receive your name, email address and an account identifier. Nothing else – no contacts, no calendar, no password. With «Hide My Email» we only receive a forwarding address from Apple. The privacy policies of Google or Apple also apply to the sign-in. We delete the link together with your account.

After your first sign-in, Pickeed asks once «What do you use Pickeed for?» (privately, as a creator, as a provider or for a company). Answering is optional («Later» works too) and you can change it in your profile. We store the answer with your account; it only controls which guidance you see, grants no rights and is visible to nobody else. It is included in your data export and deleted with your account.

First start (optional, every question can be skipped): «What do you like doing?» (interests from a fixed list and up to three words of your own) and «Where are you?» (your town = home town in your profile). We use both only to show you matching things first in «Discover» and in suggestions – nothing is hidden, nobody else sees it, no advertising. Under «Who do you already know?» we only suggest people from shared plans and invitations; we never upload your phone contacts. Username: if you don’t choose one, Pickeed assigns one from your name (e.g. lea.graf; under 18 or with «Show first name only» just your first name and four digits) – you can change it at any time. It is shown small under your name on your profile, findable in search and usable for mentions in chat. A public page pickeed.com/@name only exists once you confirm it or choose your own. For a private account it only shows your name, photo, @username and «Private account». People’s pages never appear in search engines. «Show first name only»: others only see your first name; we store your full name only for you. Everything is included in your data export and deleted with your account.

Members of a plan with an account can upload photos. They are only visible to the members of that plan and are only delivered to signed-in members – there are no public links. The app shrinks photos before uploading; our server also removes all photo data such as location (GPS), camera and date. The Pickeed team has no access to photos in plans; photos cannot be reported either. We delete photos with the plan and with the account of the person who uploaded them; your own photos are included in your data export. One year after a plan, Pickeed reminds its members once («One year ago today»).
Travel building blocks: deadlines, notes, trusted people and emergency info

We store deadlines (e.g. passport, visa, vaccinations), your packing list progress and notes on them per person. For shared deadlines and personal items, the organisers only see how many people are ready – small counts (below three, below five in company plans) only as «fewer than …», never who and never your notes. Private notes («Just for me») are only visible to you, even if someone joins the plan later. Deadline reminders arrive as in-app notifications.

You add trusted people yourself (name and, optionally, email address). They receive a secret link that lets them see your route, the current stage and your last «All good» without an account – read-only, without accommodation addresses and without the chat. If you give an email address, we send the person the link with their own confirmation code; you only see the link once they have confirmed. We only send emails («All good», reminder, notice when a check-in is missing) after this confirmation and only a limited number per day; they can unsubscribe at any time with the link in every email – this applies permanently to their address (we only store a check value for this, not the address). You can remove trusted people at any time; the link then stops working immediately, and at the latest 14 days after the trip. Pickeed does not know or store anyone's location and does not alert the authorities. The organisers switch the family link of a group trip on and off; it only shows the route and current stage, no names.

You provide emergency info (e.g. insurance, emergency contact, blood type, allergies) voluntarily and with your explicit consent (tick box when you first save, stored with time and version); deleting it withdraws your consent. We store it encrypted and only you can see it – trusted people only if you explicitly switch this on for a plan. Emergency numbers and country details are general data with no link to you. So that the route, accommodation, your deadlines, the emergency numbers and the destination's Travel Guide can be read on the go without a connection, the app saves them for members on your device (browser storage) – but not your personal emergency info or the links for trusted people. This data belongs to your account and expires (one week after the trip, after 60 days at the latest); we delete it there when you sign out, when your sign-in has expired or when you no longer have access to the plan. The family link is valid until 14 days after the trip at the latest. If you leave a plan, we delete your deadline progress, notes, trusted people and check-ins in that plan; deleting your account also deletes your emergency info. You enter exchange rates for expenses in foreign currencies yourself – Pickeed does not call any outside service for them.

If a plan is marked as «outdoors», our server requests the weather forecast from Open-Meteo (Open-Meteo.com). For this we only send the plan's location as a town or city (e.g. «Bern», never an address) or coordinates derived from it, rounded to about one kilometre – no information about you or your group. We store the forecast for at most two days. Weather data: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

If you have entered a home town in your profile, Pickeed uses it approximately to suggest places in Idea Pick that are about equally far for everyone. For this our server determines rough coordinates (rounded to about one kilometre) from the place name via Open-Meteo's place search; only the name of the town or city is sent – never a street, house number or postcode, even if you entered more. We only store place names with their rough coordinates, never who lives where. Nobody sees distances, coordinates or other people's home towns – not in profiles either; it only applies once at least four members have entered a home town.

In some places Pickeed may show partner links, always labelled «Partner link»: shop links on the wish list, «Get it online» in the list of what to bring, trips and outings with a fixed place and date («Find accommodation», «Tickets & experiences», «Getting there»), the Travel Guide («Book experiences», «Find accommodation») and partner offers in Idea Pick, «Ideas for you», «Find something» and Discover – there only after the real results and only matching the occasion, place, category or search term, never based on chats or your profile. Partner links run through the Awin partner network (Awin AG, Berlin, Germany). When you open one, our server forwards you via Awin to the partner's site.

Pickeed does not pass on any personal data in the process: the link contains the destination address and a click reference that only says where in Pickeed the link was shown (e.g. «wish» for the wish list) – no information about you, the group or the plan, no identifier and no email address. For trips and outings, the destination address contains the destination (city, never an address) and the travel dates; in the Travel Guide, only the name of the destination; in the list of what to bring, the link searches for a general keyword, never for your entry; on the wish list, it is the shop link that was entered. Pickeed sets no additional cookies for this and only counts how often partner links are opened per day, partner and placement – not who it was; nothing about it appears in the group. Only on their own sites do Awin and the partner record the click (e.g. IP address, browser details, cookies) so that a purchase or booking can be attributed to Pickeed; they are responsible for this themselves, and their privacy policies apply. If you buy or book, Pickeed receives a small commission; your price stays the same.

Pickeed chooses the ideas suggested in a plan (idea library, Travel Guides) only from the plan's details: occasion, the plan's name and place, date or season, group size, budget and – for outdoor plans – the weather. We never use chat messages or home towns for this. With «Find something» you search ideas, Travel Guides and offers; only what you pick is posted. For statistics, we count search terms only in a normalised form and without name, account or plan: per day, how many different plans searched for a term. So that a plan isn't counted twice, we store a check value using a random key that changes every day; keys and check values are deleted after 7 days. Terms that were not searched in at least 5 different plans during that time are also deleted after 7 days, all others after 60 days. Likewise, we only count as a total how often an idea was added or chosen; this only affects the order from 5 different plans upwards. The Pickeed team only sees these totals from 5 plans upwards – never who searched.

The small map in the Travel Guide is made of map images from OpenStreetMap. Your device only loads them from our server; our server fetches them from OpenStreetMap and caches them for up to seven days. OpenStreetMap only sees our server – never your IP address, your account or your plan; all it receives is which map section is needed. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). «On map» opens your device's maps app (e.g. Apple Maps or Google Maps) with the name of the entry and the destination as a search; what its provider records is governed by its privacy policy.

Map and route for plans and events: when you type a place under “Where?”, Pickeed suggests matching places. For this our server sends only the text you typed to the search service Photon (komoot GmbH, Germany; data from OpenStreetMap) – never your account, your IP address or your plan. If you choose a suggestion, we save the place's position with the plan; the map is made of map images that your device only loads from our server, as in the Travel Guide. If you tap “Walking route”, your device asks for your location. With your permission, our server sends your location and the destination once to the routing service openrouteservice (HeiGIT gGmbH, Germany), which calculates the walking route – without any information about you. We don't save your location; the moving dot on the map stays on your device. “Open in Maps” opens your device's maps app; what its provider collects is governed by that provider's privacy policy.

Sharing your location in the plan chat (voluntary, 18+): If you tap “Share location” in the chat of a private plan and choose a time (15 minutes, 1 hour, 8 hours or until the plan ends, at most 12 hours), the other participants in the plan see your exact location on the plan’s map until the time is up or you tap “End”. Your device only sends your location while Pickeed is open – never in the background. Our server only keeps the latest position in memory and deletes it when sharing ends; we do not store any location history and do not write positions to any logs. We only store that you are sharing and until when, plus the time of your consent the first time (included in your data export). The legal basis is your consent; you can end sharing with one tap and withdraw your consent at any time. People under 18, guests without an account, business and creator accounts and public events are excluded; people you have blocked or hidden from never see you.

“Nearby” and place pages: if you tap “Nearby” in “Discover”, Pickeed shows on a map plans in the next 7 days within 5 km – only plans you also see in your feed, from people you follow (approved). From 18 (with the “at least 18” confirmation) public events are added. If you are 16 or 17 or haven’t confirmed “at least 18”, you only see plans from friends there (you follow each other) and no public events. You choose who sees your plans on the map in the settings under “Who sees you on ‘Nearby’?”: followers (default), close friends, selected people or nobody; your choice applies until you change it. Private stays private: no option shows your plans to people who aren’t approved followers of yours; if you are 16 or 17, only friends who follow each other with you see them – there is no “public” there. We store your choice and selection in your account; they are included in your data copy and deleted with your account; nobody finds out whether they were selected. The centre is the city in your profile or – if you tap “My location” and allow it – your location. It is sent to our server only for this one request and is not stored, logged, cached or passed on; only a centre rounded to about one kilometre comes back. For “Venues nearby” (sports meetups) our server sends the place search Photon only the search term and this rounded centre; we cache results only under the name of your city, never under a position. On a place’s page you see upcoming public events at that place and which of your friends (you follow each other) have said yes and want to show it, with name and profile picture. Plans with people under 18 only appear there for people who are mutual friends with the organiser and with every person under 18 in the plan – never for strangers; they never appear on place pages.

For places without their own Travel Guide, Pickeed shows a «Travel Guide light» from our own data only (country, power, currency, emergency numbers, country map) – without any external place search. If you tap «Request a Travel Guide for …», we only count how often a place was requested; so that each person counts only once, we store a check value from which neither your account nor the plan can be read.

If you tick «Also recommend to other travellers» when suggesting an idea, we store the title, short description, section, language and the trip's place (with country) – never the plan, names, chat or members. We only keep a link to your account for the limit of 10 recommendations per day and for deletion; it is never shown. Others only see a recommendation after the Pickeed team has reviewed it, without names and in your language (other languages only if we translate it). If you delete your account, we delete pending and rejected recommendations; approved ones remain without any link to you. «My data» includes your recommendations. Without this tick we never use the contents of your plans for the Travel Guide.

To improve the Travel Guide, we count anonymously once a day how many trip plans there are per place or country and month. For this we only read the «Where?» field of trip plans – never titles, ideas, chat, members or notes. We only store the place, month and number, without any link to the plan; the Pickeed team only sees a place once there are at least 10 different plans. We delete these totals after just over two years.

For regular meetings, Pickeed sends reminders in the group chat and by email about upcoming meetings and missing replies. We store which reminder was sent when, so that none arrives twice. You can turn off email reminders in your profile.

In a club (company space with a club type), parents can enter the first name and team of children under 16 without their own account and answer for them. We only store the first name, team, answers and who entered the child. Only the parents, the team's coach and the board can see this – never public, never in search or Discover. If the club or the parent deletes the entry, the answers are deleted too. If you ask for a trial training on a public club page, we store the club, your name, your message (optional) and the time and send the board a notification; we do not pass on your email address. Both are included in your data copy.

For the guestbook we store entries (text, who, when, whether approved) and your setting for who may write. Entries are visible to anyone who can see your profile; you can hide or delete any entry. Top friends is just a list of up to eight friends – they are not notified. For the profile song we only store the link, title and artist, never an audio file. When you save, we ask the service (Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube) for title and artist. Pickeed only loads the Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music or SoundCloud player once you tap the song; only then does the service receive your IP address and may set its own cookies (see the service's privacy policy).

When you upload a video, our own server only checks whether it has an audio track – we don’t listen to the content. We store your choice (“My own music”, “Rights confirmed”, “No sound”) with the video and the one-time confirmation of music rights with the date and text version in your account. “No sound” removes the audio track permanently. For a copyright notice we store the notice, counter-notice, decision and log; names and emails of rights holders without an account are seen only by the Pickeed team, the IP address only as an encrypted check value against abuse. We delete notices including contact details 6 months after the decision; the number of confirmed violations stays with the account as long as it exists.

When you upload a file, we check its metadata – on your device before it’s resized and on our own server – for AI information (Content Credentials/C2PA, IPTC/XMP “DigitalSourceType”, details of known AI tools). We don’t analyse the image content for this, and nothing is shared with third parties. We only store the result: whether the image or video is labelled as AI and where the label comes from (automatic, from you or from moderation). We remove the metadata itself as before.

You record voice messages yourself in the chat; the microphone only runs while you hold the button or until you tap Stop. On our own server we convert the recording into a small audio file (AAC, mono), remove all metadata (e.g. device) and store it with its length, a waveform and who played it when («played»). Only members of the chat can access it – there is no public address. If you delete a voice message, the file is gone immediately; if you delete your account, so are all your voice messages. If someone reports a voice message, moderation receives a copy that is deleted together with the report. Your own voice messages are included in your data copy. Notifications only say «Voice message» and the length.

Videos (up to 60 seconds) and GIFs that you send in a chat are converted on our own server into a small video file; we remove all metadata (e.g. location and device) and automatically check a few frames for sexual content – none of this goes to third parties. Only the members of the chat can retrieve them; if you delete the message or your account, the file is gone. The GIF search (“GIF”) is provided by GIPHY: when you tap it, your device loads suggestions and GIFs directly from GIPHY, Inc. (USA). GIPHY receives your search term, your IP address and technical information about your device – but no account, no name and no chat content from us. In the chat we only store the ID and address of the chosen GIF; whoever receives it also loads it from GIPHY. What GIPHY does with this information is governed by GIPHY’s privacy policy. Under 18, the search only shows GIFs rated “G”.

For meetups and experiences we store the offer (title, description, place, dates, price), bookings (who, which date, companion by first name only, payment status), the confirmation of the rules with version and time, reports and ratings. The offering party only sees the first name and the companion of people who book; contact runs via the plan chat. Stripe processes payments and the identity check (see service providers); we never see card details. For company bookings we also store the billing name, billing address and VAT number for statutory retention. A linked management sees bookings and reports of the person who confirmed the link. Bookings, ratings and consents are included in your data copy.

After a plan or event at a place, Pickeed may ask you once how it was. You can only rate places you have been to with Pickeed. We store one rating per place: the place (as written in the plan), stars, optionally a short line and one of your own Memories as a photo, the plan as proof and the time. Your rating is visible to people who follow you and to people you were at this place with – never to blocked people. Everyone else sees at most an average without names, and only from three ratings. The place page only shows what you are allowed to see anyway (Memories, ratings, your shared plans). We do not use data from map services. You can change or delete your rating at any time; when you delete your account we delete all of them. You can switch off the question after plans under “Notifications”. Your ratings are included in your data copy.
Statuses, plans and moments: likes, comments, “Seen by”

On plans, “Moments from the event” and your “Free today” status, people who are allowed to see them can like and comment (comment, person, time). On your status only you can see who viewed it (once per person, with time), who liked it and who commented – blocked people never appear. This list stays visible to you for 24 hours after the status expires; then we delete the status together with the list, likes and comments. Likes and comments on plans stay until you remove them or the plan is deleted. You can switch off notifications about this under “Comments and replies”. Status stickers (poll, emoji slider): when you vote, we store your vote with the time; the person who owns the status sees it next to your name, everyone else only the overall result. You can delete your vote at any time; otherwise we delete it together with the status. For the weather sticker only the place name (city or neighbourhood) goes to Open-Meteo; your device loads GIFs directly from GIPHY.
Who sees your status, close friends, highlights, collections and notes

For each status you choose who sees it: “Public” (with a public profile all signed-in accounts, otherwise your confirmed followers), “Followers only” (confirmed followers only) or “Close friends” (only the followers on your own list). We store the “Close friends” list with the time; the people on it are not told, but they see the green ring. “Free” is only ever seen by confirmed followers. Highlights: when you add a status to a highlight, we store a copy (text, layers, photo or video, original time and audience) – it stays until you remove it from the highlight or delete the highlight, and only people who were allowed to see the status can see it; blocked people never, strangers never for accounts under 18. “Free” cannot go into a highlight. Collections: the name and the saved posts in it, only for you or your account; posts you are no longer allowed to see drop out silently. Notes above the chats are your “Who has time for …?” posts from the last 24 hours; only people who follow you (confirmed) see them (under 18 only if you follow each other); only the person who asked sees “I’d have time”. You can delete all of this at any time; when you delete your account we delete it completely. It is included in your data copy.
Profile colour, favourite song, “Listening to …”, “My people” and songs on posts

Everything is optional. We store your profile colour (or “automatic”: then we take the closest shade of a fixed palette to the average colour of your banner), your favourite song, “Listening to …” (24 hours, then deleted), up to 8 friends for “My people” (they are not notified) and songs you add to posts. For songs we only store the title, artist and the addresses of the cover, preview and Apple Music – never music files. Song search runs through our server to the Apple iTunes Search API (Apple only receives the search term, not who is searching); we keep results for at most 7 days without any personal reference. We show covers through our server. Apple only learns something from your device (e.g. your IP address) when you tap a 30-second preview or open the Apple Music button; nothing plays by itself. Everything is visible like your banner (never to people you blocked); people under 18 never appear in “My people” for others, and for accounts under 18 only directly connected people see it. You can remove everything at any time; we delete it with your account. It is included in your data copy.

If you allow notifications on your phone, we store a device identifier so that we can send you updates about your plans. You can turn this off at any time in your device settings. The notifications are delivered via the Apple Push Notification service (iPhone) or Google's Firebase Cloud Messaging (Android); they receive the device identifier and the short notification text (e.g. plan name and the start of a message).

If you report content (e.g. a message, an image or a public event), we store who reported it, the reason, your details and an excerpt of the reported content including the author's name, so that we can review the report. We delete processed reports after 12 months at the latest. When reporting a person there is also the reason «This person is under 16»; what happens then is described under «Date of birth and age checks».

If you report an image (e.g. a photo in a plan, a cover or profile picture), we place a copy of only that one image in a protected area – never other photos or content of the plan. Only the moderation team sees this copy; every access is logged. If the reason is «risk to minors», we take the image offline straight away until we have decided; the same applies to «illegal» if the image is not public (e.g. a photo in a plan). We take public images (e.g. the cover of a public event, the picture of a creator or provider page, an offer image) offline straight away for «illegal» if there are at least two independent reports; otherwise we review them with priority within 24 hours. So that nobody can take other people's content offline by abuse, one person can take at most 5 images offline straight away per day. If we find no breach, the image is visible again and we delete the copy. If we remove the image or secure it as evidence, we keep the copy for 180 days (objection period and requests from authorities) and delete it afterwards – unless an authority requires us to keep it longer. If we suspect child sexual abuse material, we inform the competent authority (fedpol).
Without an account you can report content via

. We then store the address of the content, the reason, your description, your language, optionally your email address (for the confirmation of receipt and the decision) and a check value of your IP address against abuse (never the address itself). We delete your email address and the check value of your IP address 6 months after the decision, and the report itself, like all others, at the latest 12 months after it has been processed.
If you block someone, we store this so that their messages stay hidden for you; the person is not notified. You can undo this at any time in your profile.

If you join the waiting list on the home page, we store your email address, whether you are interested in iPhone or Android, your language and the time. You first receive an email with a confirmation link; without confirmation we delete the entry after 7 days. After confirmation we only write to you once the app is available for your phone, and then delete the entry. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email. We send these emails through the same email service as the sign-in codes.
If you write to us via the

(on the website or in the app), we store the topic, your name (optional), email address, message, language and time, whether you wrote via the app or the browser and – only if you come via «Report a problem» and don't remove it – the address of the page (without plan names or chats). If you are signed in, we link the message to your account and your role (e.g. company admin or provider) so that we can help you faster. To prevent abuse we store a check value of your IP address (not the IP itself). We forward the message by email to

and send you a short confirmation (without your text); the emails go through the same email service as the sign-in codes. We use the details only to answer your request and delete the stored message after 12 months. Our reply and your email thread remain in our mailbox.

For your personal referral link we store a random code. If someone creates a new account via your link, we store that it came via you and count whether it becomes active (timestamps only, no content). To prevent abuse we store check values of the IP address and browser (not the IP itself) and delete them after 90 days. You only see numbers, not names; the referred person doesn't see who referred them.

If you request a reward, we store the account holder's name, country and IBAN in order to transfer the amount to you. We store the IBAN only in encrypted form; it is shown masked and in full only to authorised team members for the transfer, and every such view is logged. If a request is declined, we delete the IBAN immediately; open requests are deleted with your account. Paid payouts are kept for 10 years because of the statutory retention obligation for business records.

If you take part in an event campaign (e.g. at a fair), we store which campaign you take part in, since when and whether you joined yourself or our team added you, and, for referrals made during the campaign, which campaign they belong to. To check for abuse, authorised team members see per participant which new accounts came via their link during the campaign (name, email address, time, whether active, number of accounts from the same address as a check value); every such view is logged. We delete your participation with your account.

If you have a reward paid out in cash at the Pickeed stand, we store country, amount and currency and, as a receipt, the place, time, paying team member, any note, and whether and when you confirmed or disputed receipt. Like paid payouts, we keep this for 10 years because of the statutory retention obligation for business records, even if you delete your account.
Identity verification and fraud protection for events with tickets or a contribution

Anyone offering a public event with a ticket price, contribution, payment options or ticket link verifies their identity via Stripe Identity. At Stripe, you photograph an official ID document and take a selfie; Stripe compares the two. Pickeed does not receive ID images, the selfie, the ID number or the date of birth. We only store your verified first and last name, the time of the check and Stripe's reference for the check. Only authorised members of the Pickeed team see the verified name, for example to compare it with the account holder of an IBAN you entered; publicly, only the «Identity verified» badge appears. Stripe keeps the verification data according to its own retention rules. If you delete your account, we delete the name and verification status immediately and ask Stripe to delete the verification data – except during an ongoing fraud investigation; in that case the data stays at Stripe until the case is resolved. As long as identity verification is not set up, the Pickeed team reviews such events manually.

To protect against fraud, we check ticket and payment links (e.g. for short links or lookalikes of well-known brands) and – if set up – with Google Safe Browsing; Google only receives the link address. We record changes to payment details in the log (account numbers shortened only) and inform the participants. «Fraud / payment» reports can temporarily hide an event; reporters learn the outcome, the organisers don't learn who reported.

When you buy a ticket, we process the order, number of tickets, amount, time, status (paid, refunded, used) and the identifiers of the payment at Stripe. Only Stripe receives card and TWINT data.
